Accommodation description

Akti Belvedere Color & Essence is an accommodation complex located in the area of Skala Rachoni, in the city of Pachis, which is only 7km away from the city of Thassos and the port of Skala Prinos. The hotel is located on the seashore, and besides its beach offers a swimming pool and jacuzzi.

Accommodation

The hotel was renovated in 2017, so all the apartments and superior rooms are modernly decorated and offer a pleasant stay.

Location and nearby beaches

Skala Rachoni, Thassos

Skala Rachoni is a quiet coastal area on the northwestern side of Thassos, surrounded by olive groves and gentle hills. The beach here is long and shallow, with fine sand in many places, making it suitable for families with young children. The sea is calm and warm, especially in the morning hours. Accommodation is mostly in small family hotels, apartments, and seaside houses set in peaceful surroundings. The atmosphere is slow-paced, ideal for travelers who want rest rather than entertainment. Nearby beaches like Pachis and Glyfada offer a similarly relaxed feel, often with natural shade from pine trees. Skala Rachoni is a good base for exploring the island, while still providing a quiet place to return to at the end of the day.
